name: _determine_ina_placement_candidates
strategic_role: Identifies and ranks the most strategically valuable switches for INA deployment based on their centrality in job traffic paths and potential to alleviate PS bottlenecks, subject to the INA budget constraint.

outputs.name: ina_placement_candidates
outputs.description: A prioritized list of switch Node IDs eligible for INA placement, reflecting their strategic value for load balancing and congestion reduction.

member_variables_read.name: self.ina_candidates
member_variables_read.description: List of all switches that can host INA, derived from network topology.

member_variables_read.name: self.workers_id
member_variables_read.description: List of worker node IDs per job, used to infer traffic patterns.

member_variables_read.name: self.ps_id
member_variables_read.description: List of PS node IDs per job, used to identify bottleneck links.

member_variables_read.name: self.sd_id
member_variables_read.description: List of ToR switches directly connected to each PS, used to locate PS-level bottlenecks.

member_variables_read.name: self.ina_budget
member_variables_read.description: Maximum number of switches that can be enabled with INA.

member_variables_written.name: self._ina_placement_candidates
member_variables_written.description: The final list of switch Node IDs selected for INA, ordered by strategic priority.

name: _assign_workers_to_aggregation_points
strategic_role: Assigns each worker to a single aggregation node—either a selected INA switch or its job's PS—while respecting INA availability, path constraints, and load balancing principles.

outputs.name: worker_agg_id
outputs.description: A nested dictionary mapping job index and worker index to the Node ID of the assigned aggregation point.

member_variables_read.name: self._ina_placement_candidates
member_variables_read.description: The list of switches selected for INA deployment.

member_variables_read.name: self.workers_id
member_variables_read.description: Worker node IDs per job, used to iterate over all workers.

member_variables_read.name: self.ps_id
member_variables_read.description: PS node IDs per job, used as fallback aggregation points.

member_variables_read.name: self.allPathDict
member_variables_read.description: Precomputed shortest paths between all node pairs, used to validate routing feasibility.

member_variables_written.name: self._worker_assignment_map
member_variables_written.description: The final worker-to-aggregation-node mapping for all jobs and workers.

name: solve_with_heuristic
strategic_role: Orchestrates the solution pipeline by executing the placement and assignment steps, validates the resulting configuration, and packages the final solution in the required schema.

outputs.name: solution
outputs.description: A dictionary containing the selected INA switches and worker-to-aggregation mappings, matching the expected output format.

member_variables_read.name: self._ina_placement_candidates
member_variables_read.description: The list of switches selected for INA deployment.

member_variables_written.name: self.solution
member_variables_written.description: The final solution object stored in the instance for downstream use.
